lines.trans: Samy completely failed his screen tests.
He just had stage fright!
Gerard wants a more solid partner.
Yet, Samy has a unique talent!
He has a great artistic sensitivity.
He does not know how to act yet.
We must think about this film.
It is really unfair to him!
One must know how to make choices.
Call Samy to break the news to him.
Hello Samy, it is Camille, your agent.
I am sorry about this role.
But we are going to continue together.
The future is big ahead of us!

meanings.note: artistic agent who finds work for actors

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Je viens vous annoncer une nouvelle.
examples.trans: I'm coming to announce some news to you.

meanings.note: takes ç before a/o: nous annonçons

examples.trans: The future of the agency is secure.
He is thinking about his future.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu as complètement perdu la tête!
Baissez les yeux devant la duchesse!
examples.trans: Lower your eyes before the duchess!
I'll wait for you in front of the cinema.

meanings.en: in front of, before (a place or person)
meanings.note: devant la porte = in front of the door

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: je suis désolé(e) = I'm sorry; désolé! alone also works
encore une heure = one more hour

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Akerfelt n'a pas aimé son essai.
Aux essais, il parlait, il parlait!
examples.trans: At the screen tests, he talked and talked!

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen
être injuste envers quelqu'un = to be unfair to someone

examples.text: Il joue le frère de Guillaume.

meanings.note: jouer un rôle, jouer le frère de...
jouer au foot, jouer du piano

examples.trans: I just want to see Mathias.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.text: C'est ma partenaire dans le film.
examples.trans: She is my co-star in the movie.

meanings.note: same form for masculine and feminine

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all
je le pense: I mean it

meanings.note: pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: You're going to miss your plane.

meanings.note: a train, a plane, an opportunity

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)

examples.trans: Do you know where he is?

savoir.gloss: to know; to know how to

meanings.note: je ne sais pas = I don't know

examples.text: Il a une grande sensibilité artistique.
examples.trans: He has a great artistic sensitivity.

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned, not the owner
avoir du talent = to be talented
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: J'ai toujours le trac avant d'entrer en scène.
examples.trans: I always get stage fright before going on stage.

meanings.note: avoir le trac = to have stage fright (final c is pronounced)

examples.text: Oui, elle a un timbre unique.
examples.trans: Yes, she has a unique timbre.

meanings.note: + noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
